level: >= 25% of book equity from the high-water mark
observable_from: /blend/feed equity_curve (X-Read-Token; one point per cycle-day; HWM and DD computed by hand from it — the executor tracks no HWM). NOT /status (intraday marks only, no history)
basis: executor-fidelity replay of the live 30/70 rules: realized max DD 28.3% (2020-02-20 -> 2020-03-23, SPY-led), bootstrap p5/p50/p95 14.6/26.3/40.1%; the sleeve-led 2022 bear reached 20.4% on the book
action_as_coded: none on the book; a written review within 5 sessions (fills vs entry_ref, missed entries, stop placement, unreconciled, regime) logged in this ledger
review_rule: re-derive from the then-current mirror results JSON; re-arm or re-level; 'resolved' = fired (date in notes) or superseded
notes: Written 38 days AFTER go-live (money moved 2026-08-28), against the IC rule that tripwires precede money; recorded as such. Measured-curve caveat: book_value credits no SPY dividends or BIL distributions (cash reconcile is alert-only), ~2 pp/yr of drag vs the total-return replay, so live drawdowns read deeper and underwater clocks longer than the replay basis.

level: >= 35% of book equity from the high-water mark
basis: P(max DD >= 35% over 10.6y) = 12.4% under the replay's own bootstrap (a LOWER bound: survivor reshuffles, 21-day blocks destroy regime persistence). With SPY at 70% weight a 35% book drawdown is a ~45-50% SPY event; it is consistent with the replayed engine and says nothing about the sleeve
action_as_coded: review the CORE weight decision (the 30/70 construction), not the sleeve; explicitly NOT a sleeve flatten — selling the sleeve into an index trough is the harm a halt rule causes; nothing automatic
source: same JSON; exceedance recomputed from the committed cache with the mirror's bootstrap construction (seed 20261001, 2,000 draws): P(>=25%) 0.54, P(>=30%) 0.30, P(>=35%) 0.124, P(>=40%) 0.051
notes: A halt rule was never replayed. On the live-rules curves the 25% line is first crossed 2020-03-20 (book; trough 03-23) and 2020-03-09 / 2023-02-21 (sleeve alone; troughs 04-09 / 03-10): near the trough, not at it.

level: >= 45% of sleeve equity from its high-water mark on a TRANSFER-ADJUSTED basis
observable_from: NOT OBSERVABLE YET: the executor exposes no transfer-adjusted sleeve curve and no HWM (sleeve_value moves with REBALANCE transfers). Instrument = next build: executor-side sleeve HWM on a transfer-adjusted basis + an ALERT-ONLY tripwire; until then this line is written, not armed
basis: sleeve-only live-rules replay (exec_t2_carry): realized max DD 29.4% (2020-03-09 -> 2020-04-09), bootstrap p5/p50/p95 22.6/33.4/52.2%, longest underwater 1,269 d (2021-01-19 -> 2024-07-11); P(>=45%) = 0.13, P(>=50%) = 0.067 (lower bounds). 45% sits above the realized and the median and inside the p5-p95 cone: a breach says this is not the engine that was replayed, at a ~13%-per-decade false-kill rate
action_as_coded: /kill as coded: cancels the sleeve's stops and MKT-sells st.positions only (SPY and BIL untouched); proceeds land in sleeve CASH and are swept to BIL only after /resume (step() returns nothing while halted); /kill also halts the parked ladder. /resume clears EVERY halt with no review gate: the written review is a human rule, nothing enforces it
review_rule: arm when the instrument ships; then same as above
source: same JSON variants.exec_t2_carry.windows.full + .bootstrap.full; exceedance recomputed as above
notes: Sleeve-in-blend curve with flows included reached 28.1% in the replay; that series is not the right basis (transfers move it), hence transfer-adjusted.

level: >= 30 calendar months below the high-water mark
observable_from: same as line 1 (HWM date from the feed curve)
basis: replay longest underwater for the live 30/70 rules: 715 d (~23.5 months, 2022-01-03 -> 2023-12-19); the sleeve alone 1,269 d (~42 months). A single realized number, no duration distribution (the bootstrap destroys persistence): 30 months = 1.28x the book's worst, a review line only
action_as_coded: written review; the sleeve weight (BLEND_SLEEVE_TARGET) is the only lever and only via a new pre-registered study; nothing automatic
notes: Dividend/BIL-distribution drag (~2 pp/yr, unmeasured by the ledger curve) lengthens the measured clock by ~5% of equity over 30 months; read the clock with that in mind or build stage-2 cash adoption first.
